title: Ginger Chicken Noodle Soup with Bok Choy
summary: A light Chinese-inspired lunch soup with tender chicken, warming ginger, rice noodles and crisp bok choy in a savoury broth. It is dairy-free, quick to cook, and soothing without being heavy.

ingredients.name: bok choy, leaves separated and larger stems sliced
spring onions, sliced, whites and greens separated

steps: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions until just tender, then drain and rinse briefly under cool water to stop them sticking. Set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the ginger, garlic and the white parts of the spring onions, and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant but not browned.
Pour in the chicken stock and bring to a gentle boil. Add the soy sauce, black pepper and salt, then reduce to a simmer.
Add the sliced chicken breast and simmer for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink in the centre.
Add the bok choy stems first and simmer for 2 minutes, then add the leaves and cook for another 1–2 minutes until bright green and just wilted.
Divide the noodles between bowls. Ladle over the hot chicken, bok choy and broth, then finish with sesame oil and the green parts of the spring onions before serving.
